_: The vertical lines each host's text sits on, by name, with the arithmetic that puts it there. alignment.spec.ts measures the LEFT EDGE OF THE TEXT (a Range over the element's contents, not the box) of every element the selectors find, at 1500px wide, and fails any that is more than `tolerance` from every named line. A line with an `open` note is a disagreement recorded, not approved: it is listed so the spec is green today and so the day it is fixed the entry is deleted, like parity-allow.json. Add a line only with its sum.

box.why: the rail's padding; section labels and any control's box edge

inset.why: box 16 + 1px border + 12px field padding; the text inside every field, the upload button and the mode buttons (a transparent 1px edge)

box.why: the rail's padding; the title, its caption, every group label

inset.why: box 16 + 1px border + 12px field padding; the label inside every dial row

chip.why: box 16 + the zone chip's 12px padding, no border

tabs.why: canvas 264 + bar padding 24 + tab button padding 8; Words, and the mode label under it (shell.css: 32px = 24 + 8)

submenu.why: tabs 296 + the mode label's fixed 154px box + 8px, so the submenu sits under the Scale tab

baselines._: Pairs across the rail/canvas split that must share a baseline, in every canvas mode. Measured from the first line of text, not the box.

pairs.why: the header row: ReCal Builder and the scene tabs (shell.css .canvas-bar, +2px)
the second row: the rail caption and the mode label (shell.css .mode-row .mode-label, 8px - 3px)
the label and every item of the submenu the mode shows are one row (shell.css .mode-row, align-items: baseline)

steady.why: the row holds still between modes -- it dropped 4px on Paragraph only until 2026-09-25
